papers.authors: Julian Agudelo, Alberto Tonda, Gabriela Ochoa, Vincent Guigue, Cristina Manfredotti, Evelyne Lutton
papers.evidence: 搜索轨迹网络可对优化算法动态进行可视化与比较，可用于符号回归方法比较
papers.tldr: 搜索轨迹网络(STN)是可视化优化算法行为的图工具，但依赖搜索空间离散化，难以用于高维或连续问题。本文在语义空间构建STN，以模型在固定样本上的预测向量为语义向量，通过归一化Hamming距离和凝聚聚类将其离散化为节点。用于多种机器学习算法时能恢复已知差异，用于神经网络训练动态分析时发现，真实标签训练比随机标签产生更密集、高效和中心化的网络。该工作为跨算法比较学习行为提供了通用工具。
papers.abstract_en: Search Trajectory Networks (STNs) are a graph-based tool for visualizing and characterizing the behavior of optimization algorithms. STNs' reliance on discretization of the search space has largely confined them to low-dimensional or combinatorial settings. We introduce a methodology for constructing STNs in semantic spaces, defined as the space of a model's predictions on a fixed sample set. Our approach discretizes semantic vectors and aggregates them into network nodes via agglomerative clustering with complete linkage under a normalized Hamming distance. Since any predictor can be summarized by its semantic vector, this method enables comparison of learning dynamics across otherwise incomparable algorithm families. We apply semantic space STNs to classification and regression tasks solved using different machine learning algorithms, recovering known qualitative differences between them. Additionally, we use semantic space STNs to study neural network generalization by contrasting standard training with the label randomization regime of Zhang et al. (2017). The resulting STNs exhibit consistent structural differences, training on real labels produces denser, more efficient and more centralized graphs than training on shuffled labels. Together, our results show that semantic space STNs capture functional training dynamics arising from the interaction between learning algorithms and data, providing a tool for analyzing and comparing learning dynamics across machine learning models and training regimes.

papers.title_en: Scientific Knowledge Discovery in the Age of Large Language Models
papers.authors: Eleni Adamidi, Serafeim Chatzopoulos, Thanasis Vergoulis
papers.evidence: 综述了基于LLM的文献检索与筛选，支持自主研究。
papers.tldr: 在学术文献数量急剧增长的今天，常规检索系统过度依赖人工编写查询和繁琐的全文筛查，使科研人员面临严重的信息过载。生成式大语言模型以其强大的自然语言理解与生成能力，为文献检索和基于纳入标准的候选研究筛选提供了高效的新方案。本综述基于OpenAIRE Graph进行布尔检索，从1589篇记录中筛选出34篇同行评审论文，系统分析了所用的LLM类型、模型访问与适配策略、提示工程与系统架构，以及真值来源与评估指标。研究发现生成式LLM能显著减少人工筛查工作量，但缺乏统一的评估基准。这项工作为利用LLM辅助科学知识发现提供了全面的方法学参考，有助于推动下一代自动化文献综述工具的发展。
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of scholarly literature has made identifying relevant publications increasingly difficult, and conventional search systems still depend heavily on manually formulated queries and effortful manual inspection. Generative large language models (LLMs) offer a more flexible alternative, supporting literature retrieval and the screening of candidate studies against eligibility criteria. This chapter surveys 34 peer-reviewed papers applying generative LLMs to these two tasks, identified via a Boolean search over the OpenAIRE Graph (1,589 records screened to 34 inclusions). Reviewed studies are characterised by LLMs employed, model access and adaptation, prompting and architectural techniques, ground-truth sources, and evaluation metrics.
